description:
Client for the Pangolin zero-trust network access platform.

Pangolin is the Windows client of the Pangolin security and networking platform. It provides zero-trust access to private resources, stays in the system tray, and connects to Pangolin Cloud or a self-hosted instance.
What's Changed
- Add per-organization settings storage so each organization can optionally apply its own set of settings
- Separate settings into general settings and connection settings
- Add the ability to set and enforce connection settings for specific organizations from the Pangolin server
- Move logs to about page
Full Changelog: https://github.com/fosrl/windows-linux/compare/windows-0.16.0...windows-0.17.0
